topic: Simple inertial navigation system block diagram.
syllabus_extract: Simple inertial navigation system block diagram.
specific_objectives: 14.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain and define a position on the earth.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of INS Block Diagram components using PPT slides; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an Inertial Navigation System?
Define the term 'inertial' in the context of navigation.
List three basic parameters required to define a position on the earth.

development.content:
Definition of Simple INS
Core components of INS
Function of Accelerometers
Function of Gyroscopes
Integration process basics

Interpretation of Block Diagram
Signal flow analysis
Coordinate transformation
Position calculation logic
Velocity to position integration

Earth position definition
Latitude and Longitude
Altitude measurement
Reference frame alignment
System initialization concept

summary_questions: Explain how the INS block diagram converts acceleration into position.
Describe the role of the gyroscope in maintaining the reference frame within the block diagram.
home_assignment_question: Draw a simple block diagram of an INS and label the input sensors and output position coordinates, preparing to discuss error sources in the next lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Different errors in INS., initial leveling error, initial tilt error, accelerometer error, integrator error, initial azimuth misalignment, azimuth gyro drift, and leveling gyro drift.
